description: Administrators only, and this one CHANGES things: mark a company as one of ours — our own, a test somebody here made — or take the mark off. The funnel's 'firstSession' leaves our companies out, so that 'external' means somebody who came from outside. A company that is not billed, or the demo, is ours whatever the mark says. Answers the company's row with 'ours' and 'oursBy' (marked, not-billed, demo).

ours.description: True to mark it ours, false to take the mark off.
